mapper.select: SELECT article_id, user_id, emoji, create_time FROM article_reactions WHERE article_id IN #{articleId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_reactions(article_id, user_id, emoji, create_time) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, #{emoji}, #{createTime}) ON CONFLICT (article_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET emoji = EXCLUDED.emoji, create_time = EXCLUDED.create_time
